articles.title: China hands down a life sentence to the founder of property giant Evergrande
body: The move comes as diplomats and global markets continue to watch the situation closely, with the broader implications still being weighed across international affairs.
Much of the attention so far has centred on Evergrande, and that's likely to continue in the near term.
Whether this marks a lasting shift or a temporary adjustment is likely to become clearer over the coming weeks.
